environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate but fronted by AWS API Gateway (WebSocket API type) with a $connect route integration that enforces Lambda authorizer validation including Origin header verification against registered domain allowlist. pgBouncer runs in session pooling mode (pool_mode=session) with server_prepared_statements=yes and disable_pqexec=1 configuration, which forces all queries through the extended query protocol with mandatory parameterization - any query containing multiple SQL statements or non-parameterized dynamic content in the query string triggers pgBouncer's query validation layer to reject the packet. Additionally, the RDS PostgreSQL instance has a restricted search_path (SET search_path TO app_schema) and the app_user role has column-level SELECT grants only on the four allowed tables with no access to pg_catalog or information_schema.

config.api_gateway: AWS API Gateway WebSocket API with Lambda authorizer on $connect
config.rds_role_grants: column-level SELECT on orders, invoices, shipments, products only
